description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Banana is a high-quality dry pelleted food for tortoises. It is formulated with a banana flavor that tortoises love to eat, which makes it a great choice even for picky individuals. The pellets are made from all-natural ingredients, including oats, corn, oat bran, alfalfa, beet pulp and calcium carbonate, with no artificial colors or preservatives.

The nutritional profile is carefully designed for optimal tortoise health - with a high fiber content of 12% that supports healthy digestion, a low protein content of 7.6% that matches a tortoise's natural diet, and a rich calcium content of 1.9% for strong bones and a healthy shell. The food also contains vitamin D3, which helps with calcium absorption.

Before feeding, soak the pellets in warm water for a few minutes so they soften and are easier to eat. This food is suitable for European tortoises, Russian tortoises and most other tortoise species. HabiStat is a renowned British brand specializing in reptile equipment and food, known for the quality and reliability of its products.
